scope: Completed JSON-only CPU analysis; no model, GPU, simulation, fitting, or new cohort. Raw MSE is not compared across representations.

access_contract.observed_future: Actual future encoding: tautological zero-error reference, not prediction.
access_contract.clean_rollout: Only real frame 0 plus executed actions; all subsequent states predicted.
access_contract.teacher_forced_prefix: Each step receives all real past frames through that step; no future frames.
access_contract.shifted_observed_carry: Copies the latest real encoding at every step; extra observations, no learned dynamics.
access_contract.initial_carry: Only initial encoding, repeated over the horizon; no dynamics.
access_contract.interventions: Same clean target; global different-episode initial, zero initial, valid-step action-order shift and other-episode actions.

limitations: Wrong-action interventions measure dependence, not accurate counterfactual predictions.
Observed targets are model coordinates; low normalized error does not establish retention of task-relevant physical information.
Clean rollout starts at one real frame; native planning has history3 and horizon5, so this is not identical to a complete CEM episode.
Teacher-forcing gap is an input/history intervention, not an additive causal attribution of error.
Old TF6000/12000 roots contain no matched common64-window transition audit; renderer health is not substituted for clean latent forecasting.
23342 is two loader lengths and 18.69% of the original LR schedule, not a proof of convergence.
